offer.text: It's a fine evening for a walk, and I'd feel safer — happier — with you beside me. Let me lead us out to the next village and back. Keep the dark off us and I'll keep the company sweet.

accept.text: Then give me your arm and let's not hurry.

decline.text: Another evening, maybe. I'll hold you to it.

in_progress.text: Stay close — the stars are better shared.

ready.text: What a walk that was. I didn't want it to end.

complete.text: I'll remember this evening a long while. You make the whole world feel safer.
